title: Cloud City: Data Processing: Dataflow (Beam), Dataproc & Cloud Composer
city_concept: City Water Treatment Plant & Filtration Sluices

beats.name: The City Problem
beats.story: Muddy river water was pouring into city taps because the water department had no filtration sluices to separate silt, leaves, and clean water.

beats.name: The City Solution
beats.story: Hydraulic Engineer Hugh designed tiered filtration basins (Dataflow): fast settling pools for continuous flow (Streaming) and overnight settling tanks (Batch).

beats.name: City Under Stress
beats.story: When storm runoff brought heavy debris late at night, automated overflow sluices (Allowed Lateness) routed silt to secondary holding basins.

beats.name: Where Metaphor Breaks
beats.story: Physical water filters clog with sand; software pipelines scale compute workers dynamically to process gigabytes of data per second.
